verdict.rationale: Reflect ships a built-in AI palette: you highlight text, press cmd+j, and choose prompts such as 'list key takeaways' or 'list action-items', or enter free-form and saved custom prompts. You can also chat with a filtered set of notes to ask questions, and pick GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet. Scoping happens through text selection and search filters (date, tags, backlinks, pinned), which gives some control over what the AI sees. Missing for 10: documented privacy controls over what note data is sent to OpenAI/Anthropic (opt-out, retention, how it interacts with E2E encryption), explicit drafting/generation documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality and grounding.
